title: Dongfang Taiyi's Phantom
summary: The Thousand-Armed Divine Demon mocks the Old Madman for giving his life to protect 'ants', and the Old Madman answers that protecting others is humanity's foundation. Ye Fan comes back instead of fleeing, touches the flow of time with the Xing Secret, and powers up the Old Madman with the Jie Secret. Together they attack with Taiyin (the Old Madman) and Taiyang (Ye Fan), the art humans once used to kill ancient monsters. The combined yin and yang wakes the phantom of Dongfang Taiyi, the human demon and ancient Great Saint who fed on ancestral kings, from a Divine Source fragment inside Ye Fan's cauldron. The ancient clans flee at the sight of it. The Old Madman calls Ye Fan humanity's successor, passes him the essence of the Six Paths Reincarnation Fist, and chases the warship beyond the frontier. Months later Ye Fan finds a piece of the warship stained with saint's blood and mourns him. At a grand gathering, Bajing Palace posts a bounty for Ye Fan, and Yin Tiande (Immortal Platform 3rd Heaven) vows blood for his brother Yin Tianzhi.
events: The Old Madman's speech on protecting humanity

Months later a bloodied warship fragment is found
Yin Tiande vows revenge for Yin Tianzhi; Bajing Palace hunts Ye Fan
cultivation: Ye Fan is called an 'ant at Immortal Platform 2nd Heaven' (07:57). Yin Tiande: Immortal Platform 3rd Heaven (17:39 caption). Dongfang Taiyi: ancient Great Saint (caption).
